title: Remove hard-coded-version in assets URL
issue_title: Refresh js when new strore's upgraded to new version
issue_body:
I offer to add the version of the store to JS and maybe css, so when the store would be upgraded the customer's browser will upgrade JS (and maybe :) css) automatically.

` <script type="text/javascript" src="https://napompe.ru/themes/core.js" ></script>`
replace with
 `<script type="text/javascript" src="https://napompe.ru/themes/core.js?1742" ></script>`

I belive this one https://github.com/PrestaShop/PrestaShop/issues/10288 is related with cached JS.

It's easy to refresh cache on the desktop browser but on mobile it's much more complicated (for common user).

```
themes/classic/templates/_partials/javascript.tpl
{foreach $javascript.external as $js}
  <script type="text/javascript" src="{$js.uri}?1742" {$js.attribute}></script>
{/foreach}

I don't know how to insert version automatically.
```

title: Fixed bug with friendly URLs and Media Servers
issue_title: Fixed bug with friendly URLs and Media Servers
issue_body:
### Describe the bug When "Friendly URLs" are enabled together with Media Servers, there's a race condition where it will result in 404 for images either on the Media Server URL or the actual shop URL.
The issue is caused by wrong rewrite rules and the lack of a rewrite rule matching the shop domain. The bug isn't directly apparent on Apache 2.4.x servers because Apache silently "fixes" the rules (`RewriteCond` ending with `[OR]` without a following RewriteCond). The fix is to include the shop domain. ### Steps to reproduce - Setup a shop
- Go to Advanced Parameters -> Performance and add a Media Server such as cdn., ideally you' want this to actually be a CDN where the origin URL is configured to shop URL.
- Go to "Shop Parameters" -> "Traffic & SEO", make sure "Friendly URL" is set to "Yes" and click "Save".

Expected result is that the image rewrite works on both the CDN/Media Server URL and shop URL at same time and the image is served as it should.
